decisions.reason: The bowl-clearance effect is already fully represented by the candidate's message-73 MODIFY; the whisk detachment details add no further bowl-state change.

Fast whisk removal for cleaning and part swapping does not change motor durability or maximum-speed duty constraints.
The source references the existing higher RPM range but does not change maximum speed, adjustment range, or speed modes.
Whisk detachment and cleaning usability do not affect the device's beige and green color scheme.
The source does not change the DJ-turntable visual theme or decorative controls.
